items.headline: Cypherpunk Buys the $ZEC Dip After Mining Debut
items.summary: Cypherpunk bought 3,775 more $ZEC for about $3.5M at roughly $920, leaning into the dip as its mining debut posted $2.6M operating profit.

items.headline: $COW Goes Live on Solana With Intent Trading
items.summary: $COW’s CoW Swap launched direct intent-based trading on Solana, expanding from cross-chain routes into native swaps on the network.

items.headline: $KMNO Ships New App, Eyes Omni Pilots for 2027
items.summary: $KMNO’s Kamino rolled out a new app with its ONE swap engine live, and pitched Omni for institutional tokenized portfolios by 2027.

items.headline: $SAFE Wallet Drained of $6.4M via Roles Module
items.summary: A delegated-roles gap let an attacker drain $6.4M from a $SAFE wallet, exposing how risky trading permissions can become a single point of failure.

items.headline: $SOL Drops Mainnet Beta Label, Adopts v1.0
items.summary: $SOL retired the mainnet beta tag and adopted protocol version 1.0, a symbolic maturity milestone for the network’s shared client standard.
